Got it—you’re trying to set up the Seismic integration, but you don’t see the “external credentials” option.

Your role/permissions don’t allow managing external credentials

The external credentials feature isn’t enabled for your org/tenant

Seismic integration is available, but credential management is restricted to admins/IT

The recommended next steps are:

Confirm you’re signed in with the account that should have admin/integration management rights

Ask your IT admin (or we can route it) to verify whether “External Credentials” is enabled and whether your role is permitted to configure it

If enabled, proceed with the integration flow and provide the required Seismic credential/API details as prompted

If you tell me where you’re attempting this (which system/page you’re in when looking for “external credentials”), I can narrow it down and, if needed, open a ticket to get the feature enabled or permissions updated.
